title: Asset Types
search: Search asset types by name or description

customFields.title: Type-specific fields
customFields.hint: Extra fields shown in the asset form for assets of this type (for example I/O points or supply voltage).
customFields.label: Field label
customFields.errorOptions: A choice field needs at least one option.

import.title: Import asset types
import.labelRequired: field_label: when a row has a field_key
import.keyFormat: field_key: lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter
import.typeFormat: field_type: text, number, date, select, boolean or url; field_required: yes or no
import.rowsNote: One row per field: repeat the type name on every row of its fields. A row without a field_key is a type with no fields.
import.existingNote: A type that already exists is updated: the fields in the file are added or changed (a field's type cannot change) and the other fields are kept.
import.blankNote: A blank cell never clears a stored value. A type with a wrong row is left out whole.
import.nothingToDo: The file has nothing new: every asset type in it is already as the file says.
import.done: Asset types imported: {created} created, {updated} updated, {errors} errors

tagRules.title: Asset tag naming rules
tagRules.hint: New assets without a tag get the next free tag from the matching rule. Typed tags must follow the rule and be unique. The most specific rule wins: type and site, then type, then site, then all assets.

tokens.seq: running number, padded to n digits
